blocks.title: From RFQ to Container. Six Steps.
blocks.subtitle: A transparent, documented process for every order. No surprises between inquiry and delivery.

steps.title: Send Your RFQ
steps.description: Submit your product requirements, target volume, destination, and required certifications via our contact form or direct email.

steps.title: We Review Your Requirements
steps.description: Our sourcing team matches your specifications against current harvest availability, certification status, and logistics capacity.

steps.title: Receive a Detailed Proposal
steps.description: You receive a formal quotation including unit pricing, MOQ, lead time, available certifications, and a sample documentation package.

steps.title: Sample Dispatch & Lab Verification
steps.description: Upon agreement, we dispatch a product sample with full Certificate of Analysis. You verify quality before issuing a purchase order.

steps.title: Order Processing & Certification
steps.description: Your order enters our certified processing facility. All production records, batch numbers, and traceability logs are maintained throughout.

steps.title: Shipment & Documentation Package
steps.description: Cargo is loaded and sealed. You receive the full export documentation package: Bill of Lading, CoA, Phytosanitary Certificate, and all relevant certifications.

leftItems.title: Target Product & Botanical Variety
leftItems.description: Specify species and form: whole, rubbed, powder

leftItems.title: Estimated Annual Volume
leftItems.description: In metric tons — approximate is acceptable

faqs.question: What is your minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: Our standard MOQ is 500kg per SKU for stocked products. For custom processing or blending, minimum is 1,000kg. First-time buyers may request a sample order of 25–50kg with full documentation.
